appearances.title: Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs run Recursive's Flint MoE locally in 24GB of RAM
appearances.summary: Unsloth published Dynamic GGUF quants of Flint (39.8B total, 2.5B active, Apache 2.0) so it runs locally on machines with about 24GB of RAM; Unsloth reports about 125 tokens per second on a Mac and 150 on an RTX Spark, with tool calling working in Unsloth Desktop.
